title: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review prep - 2026-03-31 (draft)
content:
Purpose:
- Weekly ops sync + reliability review for SRE. Prep notes and agenda draft for 31-Mar-2026 meeting.
- Goal: highlight SLO health, paging trends, triage top incidents, review action item status, and decide follow-ups.

Attendees (TBD):
- On-call rotation: Samira Patel (primary), Aisha Khan (secondary), Jordan Lee (SRE lead)
- Invite: infra eng leads (Ethan Chen), serving-runtime oncall, product reliability PM (Rebecca Ortiz)

Agenda (45m):
1) Quick status (5m)
   - Roll call, carry-forward action items
2) SLOs & Metrics (10m)
   - Frontend API error-rate SLO (99.9% success for 95th pct) — current week: 99.83% (below target)
   - Token-generation tail latency SLO (p95 < 120ms) — current week: p95 110ms, p99 260ms (p99 breach trend)
   - Embeddings pipeline freshness SLO (<=5m) — currently 6.8m median, one outage on 2026-03-29
   - Ask: which SLOs need priority mitigations?
3) Paging trends & oncall load (8m)
   - Pager volume: 24 alerts in past 7d (avg 3.4/day) vs baseline 1.9/day — spike correlated with model-reload jobs at 03:00 UTC
   - Alert fatigue: night shifts reporting repeated noisy alerts from cluster node flaps (ALERT:node-restart-high)
   - Proposal: temp mute non-actionable flapping alerts and increase debounce to 10m for node-restart-high
4) Top incidents review (10m)
   - INC-2026-031: Serving-runtime OOM during quantized model rollout (2026-03-28)
       * Impact: degraded throughput on two dedicated pools, ~1.5h partial outage for affected customers
       * RCA: incorrect memory accounting after new allocator landing; heap fragmentation + concurrent compaction timing mismatch
       * Status: hotfix merged (PR #348), rolling restart completed, post-mortem draft in Confluence, remediation tasks assigned to serving-runtime team
       * Action owners: Ethan C. (fix backport), Samira P. (postmortem writeup)
   - INC-2026-029: Embedding freshness lag due to kicker job stuck in backoff (2026-03-29)
       * Impact: <10% of requests saw stale vectors for ~40m
       * RCA: transient DB connection burst exhausted pool, kicker did not exponential-backoff correctly
       * Fix: increase DB pool + add circuit-breaker; follow-up: implement throttling in kicker
5) Open action items & blockers (7m)
   - AI-queue monitoring dashboards (ACTION: Jordan to add a p99 token-latency panel filtered by customer tier) — due 2026-04-02
   - Mute rule for node-restart-high (ACTION: Aisha to propose runbook and temporary alert suppression) — due 2026-04-01
   - Memory accounting backport (ACTION: Ethan to schedule backport to older release branches and run soak tests) — in_progress
   - Postmortem review session (ACTION: Samira to publish draft, schedule 60m review) — due 2026-04-03
6) Risk register & upcoming changes (3m)
   - Planned infra change: kernel update on dedicated pools (2026-04-05) — risk: may re-trigger node flaps; recommendation: canary 10% nodes, hold alerts during window
   - Model rollout cadence: new quantized 8-bit models scheduled next week — request serving-runtime to provide memory footprint estimates per model before rollout
7) AOB + decisions (2m)

Notes / context / quick data snippets:
- Paging histogram (last 7d): 40% of pages between 00:00-06:00 UTC, 25% related to node restarts, 20% related to latency alerts, 15% other
- Customer impact: two enterprise customers saw degraded throughput during INC-2026-031; CS already notified; follow-up schedule with account leads on 2026-04-01
- SLO burn window: token-generation p99 breaches coincide with large batched inference jobs; working hypothesis: batching scheduler starving smaller requests during high batch build times

Draft action items (for tracking):
- Jordan Lee: Add p99 latency panel to AI-queue dashboard, filter by model and customer tier, due 2026-04-02
- Aisha Khan: Draft temporary mute rule and runbook for node-restart-high, coordinate with monitoring team, due 2026-04-01
- Ethan Chen: Backport memory-accounting fix to release branches, run soak test on dedicated pool, due 2026-04-04
- Samira Patel: Publish postmortem draft for INC-2026-031 and own review session scheduling, due 2026-04-03
- Rebecca Ortiz: Coordinate customer communications for affected enterprise accounts (CS follow-up), due 2026-04-01

Prep asks for attendee leads before meeting:
- Serving-runtime: provide memory/heap metrics per model for recent rollouts and verification steps for allocator fix
- Infra: provide kernel update plan + canary node list and rollback steps
- Monitoring: provide alert counts per alert-name last 14d and historical debounce settings

Follow-up calendar items (tentative):
- Postmortem review for INC-2026-031 — 2026-04-06 10:00 UTC (60m)
- Kernel update canary window — 2026-04-05 01:00-03:00 UTC

Draft decisions suggested for meeting:
- Approve temporary mute for node-restart-high during night windows and escalate to longer-term fix if flaps persist
- Prioritize memory-accounting backport and soak test ahead of next quantized-model rollout

Notes to self (TODO after meeting):
- Capture decisions and update Confluence incident page with timelines
- Add follow-ups to JIRA (INF-1478: memory-accounting-backport, INF-1480: node-flap-mute-runbook)
- Re-check SLO calculation window alignment with billing window and product metrics

Attachments / links to include in meeting invite:
- Postmortem draft: Confluence:Reliability-Runbook-v2
- RCA PR: GitHub:repo/inference-runtime#348
- Alerts dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ai-queue/alerts
